text:
Lena (Sales): Heads up team, BlueMesa sent an RFP. Key asks: private VPC deployment in us-west-2, FIPS-validated HSM (they called out Thales), 365d audit log retention, POC for embeddings+chat, SLA 99.95, and a capability matrix + three-tier pricing (reserved, committed, burst). They attached an RFI spreadsheet and an eval corpus.

Diego (BlueMesa): Correct. Our indexer needs steady 300 QPS for embeddings and short chat queries ~60 QPS. Target latency P95 <90ms for embeds. Embedding dim 768 mandatory. We'll need proof of HSM key import and audit trail for key usage.

Arjun (Solutions): Got it. Proposed POC scope: 1) Private cluster in us-west-2 with VPC peering; 2) HSM BYOK test using Thales emulator; 3) Perf tests at 100/300/500 QPS; 4) Embedding fidelity checks on their corpus; 5) Audit export to their SIEM. Est. prep 8 business days + 5 day run.

Marta (Security): I'll own RFI sections for crypto, key lifecycle, access controls, and audit exports. We can show FIPS/HSM integration notes and recent pen test summary. Note: exporting full content-level tokens requires DPA changes.

Nate (Product): Model options: recommend embed-768-int8 for latency/cost and embed-768-fp16 for fidelity runs. For chat, suggest a latency-optimized quant profile. I'll add a model-fidelity column to the matrix with expected perf deltas.

Arjun (Solutions): Quick infra snippet for infra team to bootstrap POC:

```
redwood_deploy:
  mode: private
  region: us-west-2
  vpc_peering: true
  nodes: 8
  node_type: a10g
  embed_dim: 768
  quant_profile: int8
  kms_provider: thales-emulator
  monitoring: datadog
```

Lena (Sales): Diego  can you confirm if BlueMesa needs subcontractor lists or SOC2 Type II attestation specifically, and whether they expect any 3rd-party audits attached?

Diego (BlueMesa): We want SOC2 Type II, pen test report within last 18 months, and a list of engaged subcontractors for the private deployment. Also pricing scenarios for reserved 12-month commit and per-token burst for nightly indexing spikes.

Jen (Legal): Heads-up: disclosing subcontractor lists triggers vendor NDA/PSP review. Also the 365d retention ask and any token-level export with content may require DPA amendments and SOW language. I'll draft the amendment template.

Marta (Security): Uploading attachments we can share: "soc2_type2_summary.pdf", "pen-test-2025.pdf", "thales_hsm_integration_note.pdf", and "audit_export_playbook.pdf". We'll populate the RFI rows for KMS, key rotation, and logging.

Arjun (Solutions): Pricing sketch: Reserved cluster for 300 QPS embeds + buffer estimated at $ZZk/mo (draft), committed 12mo discount tiers, and burst per-token for spikes. I'll produce three scenarios: cost-min, balanced, and HA.

Lena (Sales): Action items: Arjun -> finalize POC runbook + perf matrix and three pricing scenarios; Marta -> fill RFI answers + attach docs; Nate -> add model/quant guidance to capability matrix; Jen -> draft vendor-list NDA addendum & DPA note. I'll consolidate and send BlueMesa the packet by COB Thursday.

ops-bot: Infra lint for branch "bluemesa-rfp": infra plan OK, CI checks passed.

Diego (BlueMesa): Thanks, that timeline works. We'll review and propose POC dates after we get the packet. Also please include a short note on how you measure embedding drift/quality over the POC.

Nate (Product): I'll include a short embedding-drift eval section: daily COSINE similarity baselines, recall@k checks, and hallucination spot-checks for chat.

Lena (Sales): Great. Keep updates concise here. :thumbsup:
